gen-fraunces-fs-supreme: Dignified and a little bookish, Fraunces leaves its curve endings generously open, while Supreme sits beneath it, crisp and heavy through the middle of each line. Shrink the heading, though, and the difference shows.
gen-fraunces-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and tall, every bend clear of snags. Fraunces above it swells gradually from thin to thick, and that soft gradation against the body's tube-like consistency is what makes the pair work.
gen-fraunces-gf-science-gothic: Fraunces carries a dignified, bookish tone, its stems barely heavier than the arms. Science Gothic below has uniform bars and stroke ends set far apart, so give it a little extra size and each letter can be read cleanly.
gen-fraunces-gf-syncopate: Syncopate spaces its letters like rungs on a rope ladder, drawn with the steadiness of a technical pen. And Fraunces, pinched slightly where curves meet stems, gives a long run of that body some bookish warmth to lean on.
gen-fraunces-plus-jakarta-sans: Bookish, dignified and softly contrasted, Fraunces varies its line weight in a way you can plainly see. Plus Jakarta Sans follows with monoline precision, its curve endings kept well apart, so the heading's thick-thin variation stands out against it.
gen-fraunces-switzer: Fraunces has generous openings on every curve, with a thick-thin shift that stays gentle. Switzer brings wire-like, hairline-free letters under it, and that serif-against-tube difference gives the pair its dignified but approachable character.
gen-fs-alpino-bitter: Bitter is dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in each s. Alpino above it is playful, its tall x-height nearly touching cap height, so the page feels sturdy yet friendly.
gen-fs-array-archivo: Array looks futuristic and precise, its open-ended curves given room to breathe. Archivo follows with an editorial x-height and outward-opening curves, which keeps a long passage feeling approachable instead of stiff.
gen-fs-array-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Array has a futuristic precision, with big lowercase eyes and curves left open, and it is comfortable in modest doses. Be Vietnam Pro, bent like a steel rod, is its steady counterpart.
gen-fs-array-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans is sturdy and tall, its e opening clearly to the right. Array adds a futuristic, precise edge above it, and the two sit together like a crisp sign over a solid shelf.
